translator.invocation: on-demand in-region (no cross-region or global profile)

request.system_prompt: Translate the user's German news paragraph into English. Translate faithfully and completely: keep every statement, hedge, negation, number, unit and name, keep who says what (attribution and reported speech, e.g. render German reported speech with 'said', 'according to' or 'reportedly'), and keep the order of information. Do not add, explain, summarise, correct or resolve ambiguity. Output only the English translation.
request.post_processing: the answer's text blocks joined with a newline, outer whitespace stripped; reasoning blocks counted and discarded, never stored
request.failure_handling: up to 2 identical repeats after an exception (backoff 2 s, then 4 s), a stop other than end_turn or empty text; a rejection before the translator (credentials, access, validation, unknown model, throttling persisting through 6 backoffs) charges no attempt and aborts
